title: Authentication key set still valid with usable margin
note: AUTH_KEYS is a multi-line text block, reassembled from the separate datagrams its lines arrive in. REMAINING_KEYS_LESS_THAN_5 and SESSION_KEY_MISMATCH are both loco health faults, so a set close to expiry predicts a fault rather than reporting one.

title: With a cab active: “System Self-Test in progress”, “System Self-Test Success”, “Brakes Testing Success”, “Select Train Config, Press CONFIG Button”, in order (FRS 19.2, 4.3(a))

sequence.label: DMI “System Self Test In Progress”, cab active
sequence.match: field:dmi_alarm~"System Self Test In Progress" field:dmi_active_cab!=none

sequence.label: DMI “Select Train Config, Press Config Button”
sequence.match: field:dmi_alarm~"Select Train Config, Press Config Button"

note: Expected 6 (“Select Staff Responsible or Shunt Mode” after configuration) is 1.7. The brake test's own steps are 1.4/STEPS. The buzzer and 'all vital equipment normal' are manual.

title: Brake test context messages: Waiting for MR, Waiting for BP, FSB Applied, EB Applied, LEB, Waiting for Traction Command, then “Brakes Testing Success” (FRS 19.2)
note: “NSB Applied” is 'where applicable' in the SIF, so it is not required here; the buzzer is manual. The DMI is logged about once a second, so a message shown for less than that can be missed; the steps therefore have no deadline, and a brake test that ends without them leaves the case NOT ANSWERED rather than raising a finding.

title: Brake test fails (EB valve opened): stays in SB, “Brake Test Fail” and “Brake Testing Fail, Press ACK for Retesting”, brakes re-tested after ACK

sequence.label: DMI “Brakes Testing Fail” (SIF: Brake Test Fail (NSB, FSB, EB))

all_of.label: DMI “Brakes Test Fail, Press Ack for Retesting”
all_of.match: field:dmi_alarm~"Brakes Test Fail, Press Ack for Retesting"

sequence.label: brakes re-tested after ACK
sequence.match: field:dmi_alarm~"Brake Test - " OR field:dmi_alarm~"Brakes Testing Success"

note: The schema has no flag named “Brake Test Fail (NSB, FSB, EB)”; “Brakes Testing Fail” is the nearest. Opening the EB valve and pressing ACK are not in any packet, so the retest has no deadline.

note: The EM cock is the SIFA isolation cock (DIP2 pins 9/10): open NO=0 NC=1, closed NO=1 NC=0. FS, OS and PT are told from FS+OV, OS+OV and PT+OV only by LSRP's SIG_OV (ARP and the DMI do not carry it), so those six variants read LSRP; the others read LSRP, ARP or the DMI.
